'''Red 5''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps']] [[Red Group (Galactic Republic)|Red Group]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Red 5 flew a [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighter]] during a [[Battle of the Enoth system|battle]] in the [[Enoth system/Legends|Enoth system]].<ref name="Hotshot" />
